label: Slider
when: a few slides shown one at a time, with dots to flip through them (testimonials, quotes, short messages)
rules: A slider shows one slide at a time: spectra/slider holds only spectra/slider-child blocks, one per slide, each holding ordinary blocks (a quote and a name). Never set slidesPerView or slideCount. Arrows cover the edges of text slides: set "navigation":false (the dots stay); "pagination":false hides the dots. "loop":true goes back to the first slide after the last; "autoplay":true moves on by itself ("autoplaySpeed" in ms, 3000 to 10000). A slide's "backgroundColor" is a palette slug; text color is the slider's "textColor" (base on primary). No images or gradients.
example:
The bike came back running better than new, and the price was just what they quoted.

Maria, city commuter

I dropped it off before work and rode it home that evening. Friendly people, honest advice.

Tom, weekend rider

They fixed my e-bike battery when two other shops had given up on it.

Ana, daily rider
